name: Baked Plum Pudding

instructions.text: Beat the yolks and sugar together
Add the suet and spice, then the flour, moistening the mixture gradually with milk until you can move the spoon in it
Dredge the fruit and put in by degrees
Finally, stir in the beaten whites
Beat all very hard and long before baking in a buttered mould
Bake at least an hour and a half in a moderate oven
Turn out, and eat with rich sweet sauce

source.author: Marion Harland
source.originalInstructions:
1. Beat the yolks and sugar together
2. Add the suet and spice, then the flour, moistening the mixture gradually with milk until you can move the spoon in it
3. Dredge the fruit and put in by degrees
4. Finally, stir in the beaten whites
5. Beat all very hard and long before baking in a buttered mould
6. Bake at least an hour and a half in a moderate oven
7. Turn out, and eat with rich sweet sauce
